notes.title: Pre Launch Test Patch
notes.notes:
Effectively the test branch is now fully converted to the retail version. After release, update testing will be done on a separate branch. 

-Achievements will be wiped upon launching the game.
-Demo save file and stats are now your current stats in the main game. Beware that running the demo build now will remove the demo-locked weapons (slam, annihilator, microwave) from your roster, requiring you to unlock them again! Still working on this.
-The 'Sandripper' tab is now available.
-Slam Cannon ammo regeneration was accidentally different depending on which side it was on. This has been fixed and the true ammo regen stat is now 180/sec after 3 seconds.
-Decided to make the minigun spread much slower to build up and then removed its maximum spread angle because its funny.


FIXES:
-Enabled the gunship (accidentally disabled it).
-Mouse can now leave the window while in the shed.
-Tutorial crashes fixed.
-Fixed weird Cylinder wave issue.
-Passive automatic score uploading returns.

notes.title: Test Build PATCH 10.3
notes.notes:
NEW WEEKLY CHALLENGE MODE:
At last the seeded weekly gauntlet is here! Every Sunday a shared run will be generated for all players. Where which your starting loadout, enemy waves, and weapon spawns are predetermined for every player. Additionally, upgrades work a little differently, giving you only 3 options at a time and permanently removing unselected upgrades from the upgrade pool. The weekly run is more difficult than usual, thus requiring you to have unlocked every weapon in the game before you're allowed to participate. As I build out the weekly mode's wave generation it will become more unique than the regular mode. GLHF


HEALTH DROP CHANGE:
Health pickups will now become more rare over time by progressively removing each enemy's ability to drop health kits. Here is how it works:
-After wave 15 health trucks no longer spawn.
-After wave 20 Airships stop dropping health.
-After 25, Obliterators.
-After 30, Cylinders.


MISC:
-Added a resolution scale setting. The game doesn't really look great on lower scales but it will absolutely run better on old GPUs.
-Plasma rifle deals more damage but fires slower. (kinetic: 10 -> 35 | Shield: 80- > 90)
-Plasminigun's heat-based damage increase improved. Consumes more ammo.
-Fixed ammo related bugs.
-Fixed a bug that stopped rounds from progressing if there was an issue with selecting an upgrade.
-Waves will no longer progress if there's still a miniwave going on.
-Fixed laser weapons dealing 0 damage.
-Neutrino cannon consumes 300 more ammo per shot.
-Gunship health reduced.
-Gunship takes tons of damage from bombs.
-Shlugoids will now slowly die out if they're the only kind of enemy alive.
-Microwave beams cant destroy dropships before they land anymore SORRY :) 
-Tungsten Obliterator upgrade now applies properly to dragon's Rage.
-Tungsten Obliterator's blow-through more pronounced.

notes.title: Test Build PATCH 10.2
notes.notes:
CORE DUMP MECHANIC ENHANCEMENT:
For a while I've felt that core dumps were not really living up to their status, that they were just a big explosion in a sea of your other explosions. So some things have been changed to make each type of core dump allow for more intentional loadout choices...

-Irradiated enemies no longer damage themselves and others. Instead, irradiated enemies are weakened and will receive +50% kinetic damage and +300% shield damage. The radiation effect also lasts quite long.

-To accentuate this effect, the regular core dump now deals very little damage. Instead, it instantly irradiates enemies within a wide area.

-The Microwave Beam gun makes use of this radiation change by further differentiating its 2 firing modes. Regular shots no longer quickly build up radiation, but will deal extra damage to irradiated enemies. The charged up giga beam will not deal extra damage to irradiated enemies, but will irradiate them quickly.

-The Atomizer core dump has also been tweaked. Its larger, lasts longer, soaks enemies in radiation AND deals extra damage to irradiated enemies while ALSO phasing through enemies. To be exact, its damage is 54/sec. If target is irradiated, 81/sec.



MISC CHANGES, FIXES, AND IMPROVEMENTS:
-Weapon spawns now have a heavy bias toward new weapons.
-Cleansing Flames upgrade now applies to every type of core dump. It now appears later in the waves, but has received a damage increase (12hp/s -> 40hp/s).
-Neutrino Cannon projectile count doubled, and its spread increased dramatically. It feels much more like a shrapnel bomb.
-Plasma Rifle projectiles apply heat faster and will now pierce though an enemy.
-Plasminigun ammo cost reduced by 10.
-Cylinder ramming damage against enemies quintupled.
-Black hole damage increased a bit.
-Fixed a ton of crashes caused by the black hole and made turrets affected by it.
-No more jitter when driving into physics objects (still jitters at the edge of the arena though).
-Hypothetically fixed the end screen leaderboard's overextending.
-Slightly better enemy projectile contrast.
-Testing a new way to render those off-screen arrows which may improve performance. Currently they are only applied to the weapon pickups.
-New outline setting that uses duplicated offset sprites instead of a shader. This setting may improve performance for those with a slow integrated GPU. Or maybe not, let me know.
-FPS counter has been shrunk

notes.title: Demo PATCH 0.4
notes.notes:
Who knew that cramming a whole game into a half-game's worth of time causes gameplay issues! Well I'm here today to attempt to solve some of those issues, as well as streamlining one of the CORE gameplay mechanics.

The primary goal of this patch is to make your experience a bit smoother. Less confusion, more fun.

Changes to how your engine works:
-The only requirement for dumping the core is to have enough fuel. Getting your engine "hot enough" is no longer required.
-The POWER of your core dump INCREASES with engine heat.
-The SMG's firerate is now actually paired to your engine heat
The engine heat bar has been visually overhauled to reflect the changes.

Demo changes:
-Your starting ammo pool is much larger.
-During the early rounds, a health truck will always spawn if you've taken damage.
-Upgrade spawn rates have been shuffled to allow you to upgrade your core much sooner.
-You now HAVE to play the tutorial before you jump into the main game. 
-Further tutorial improvements.
-MORE achievements

Weapon balances:
-Microwave beam's normal shots deal more damage (~30 -> ~45)
-Microwave beam's normal shots build less heat -50%
-Dragons Rage shield damage obliterated (3 -> 0.5)
-Dragons Rage ammo consumption increased +50%
-Neutrino Cannon's projectile speed increased +50%
-Neutrino Cannon's projectile friction increased +25%. AKA less range, more damage
-Roach base damage increased (25 -> 30)
-Roach charge damage increased (150 -> 210)

Misc:
-Camera motion smoothness: BUTTERY
-UI pop up when a controller is connected / disconnected
-Default joystick deadzone size reduced -50%
-Default enemy outline size increased +10%
-Default aim assist increased +10%
-Default volume increased, maximum volume doubled

notes.title: Free demo release!
notes.notes:
To everyone stopping by to check out the game...
Enjoy the demo! Send me your thoughts if you have the time! There is a link to a small google form in the main menu.

So whats in the demo? And whats different compared to the base game?
The demo is 11 waves, which become more condensed much faster compared to the regular game. Because runs are less than half the length of base-game runs, you'll get weapons and upgrades very frequently. 

So get out there and FIGHT! Online or offline, gamepad or mouse and keyboard. A daily leaderboard and a new high score is waiting for you!


Follow the development on twitter: https://x.com/MackiePalmer_

Additionally, a new devlog is up on youtube: 
[previewyoutube=35CcqPbFGfA;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Test Build PATCH 9.2
notes.notes:
This patch is meant to smooth out some of the gameplay issues that come with endless mode. The goal of endless mode is to provide an increasingly-hard but increasingly open sandbox for you to play in. Of course there's a limit to how much fun the game can be with its systems, weapons, and enemies. So, the idea of an endless mode is really just a lie because really you should be dead by around the 20 minute mark ːsteamhappyː (but in a fun way).



HEALTH SCALING:
Enemy health steadily increases over the course of a round. By wave 20, most enemies will have 1.5X their base health. By wave 40 they'll have double. Certain enemies scale faster, like the Cylinder, Airship, and Obliterator.

WEAPON BALANCE:
-A fully charged Microwave Beam is no longer heat-cancelable. Spamming the giga beam was way too strong.
-The microwave beam is now impacted by "Expensive Rounds".

-The Neutrino Cannon projectiles have been tweaked a bit. They now have a maximum speed, maximum amount of enemies they can hit, and bounce off plasma shields. However, they now double their velocity and increase their friction with each tick they're inside something. Basically this means you'll get the most bang for you buck if you shove the barrel right into an enemy before firing. 

-SMGs shield damage slightly reduced


CHANGES:
-The upgrade "Expensive Rounds" can now show up again around wave 19.
-New fight for wave 21. As well as changes to the compositions of the waves after 20.
-Cylinders dash attack deals better damage to the enemies it runs over.
-Added a minimum amount of time the Cylinder should be on the ground before it can jump again.
-Cylinder slowly tracks the player as its landing.
-The CUBE is less accurate.
-Easier to see the explosion radius of active falling bombs.
-Increased the ammo refill rate of weapons that you're not currently holding. 


FIXES:
-Shlugoids now ACTUALLY don't get stuck inside rocks. For real this time I promise.
-Your hitbox is back to its previous size (it was accidentally larger).
-Running into turrets before they've landed.
-Turrets not firing the right amount of bullets.
-Dropships flickering in and out of our mortal plane.
-You can no longer die to a falling bomb while leaving a map.

notes.title: Test Build MINOR PATCH 7.41
notes.notes:
ADDITIONS

notes.title: Test Build PATCH 7.4
notes.notes:
ADDITIONS
-Credits page displaying all your names! If you are a tester and your name isn't up there, theres a form you can fill out in the announcements channel of the discord. DON'T BE SHY!
-Ability to view all previous leaderboards starting NOW. Unfortunately with the change in board naming scheme, you cant see any of the boards prior to this update.


FIXES
-Leaderboard wipe cycles are finally now 36 hours long
-Fixed those 2 achievements that would complete if you died instead of if you beat the game.



WHATS BEEN GOING ON WITH THE GAME?
Truthfully not as much as I'd like. The biggest hurdle to progress has been getting the leaderboard stuff out of the way. Which has taken months and HOPEFULLY is actually out of the way this time (please dear god). Because of the new board system, the weekly seeded mode is now possible to start work on. Other than the leaderboard work, behind the scenes I've been working on a HUGE new stationary enemy type as well as the Shlugoids. Enemy implementation and the weekly mode are the last major hurdles for the game. After those are done all there is to do is polish and ship!

Also thank you, dear viewer, for taking an interest in Sandripper. Means the world to me.

notes.title: Test Build PATCH 7.2
notes.notes:
HEALTH CHANGES
The game has had the issue of not becoming all that difficult as the waves go on. A big reason for this is more enemies = more health drops. The goal here is to make the game more, not less demanding of you as you survive longer and longer. Here are the changes:

-Player HP reduced to 4 (from 5)
-Multiplier penalty for taking damage reduced to 10% (from 20%)
-Health drops now only spawn boss enemies (Airship, Object, Obliterator)

As usual, let me know in the discord what your experience is with this change.


OPTIMIZATIONS
-All sprite stacks are now pre-stacked and turned into good old fashioned sprites. This should lighten the load for you folks with older graphics hardware. Especially for those of you who's pc screams when the airship comes on screen.
-Removed tons of wasteful enemy logic
